content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-x02-03mt136m/report.rdl

Export page 1 of this report as a PDF for me.

I can't export this report as a PDF. The pbirb tools only read and edit the .rdl file. None of them renders pages or produces PDF output, and I haven't created any file.

To get a PDF of page 1, you can:

- **Power BI Report Builder:** open `report.rdl`, select View > Page View (or Run), then File > Export > PDF. Page 1 is the first page of the output, so you can export the whole report and take that page, or set a page range in the export dialog if your version offers one.
- **Power BI Report Server or Power BI Service:** if the report is published there, open it and use the Export menu to choose PDF.

I can still help with the report itself. For example, I can check it for layout or validation problems before you export it.
